title: 100 Years
overview: The content of this film is currently a secret, due to be revealed only when the title is released in 2115.

title: Untitled X-Men Film
overview: A film set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) based on the Marvel Comics team. Plot TBA.

title: Elden Ring
overview: A live-action adaptation of the dark fantasy video game, set in the war-torn world of the Lands Between, which was once united by the Elden Ring. Plot details TBA.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum
original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum
overview: Set between The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings trilogies, Strider and Gandalf search for the corrupted Hobbit Gollum to learn more information about Bilbo Baggins' ring.

title: Unlike You
overview: A flailing screenwriter finally hits gold when he starts to implement his dreams into his stories, landing him a contract with a huge studio backing and a massive budget. But when he realizes the woman he's been seeing in his dreams is real, he begins to wonder what has been real and what been his own minds production.

title: Blair Witch Project
overview: A family goes on a camping trip and goes missing one by one after they hear strange noises in the forest.

title: In Search of Darkness '70s
overview: The Exorcist. The Omen. Halloween. Dawn of the Dead. Jaws. Carrie. The Texas Chain Saw Massacre. The Amityville Horror. Phantasm. Invasion of the Body Snatchers. Alien... The '70s were an absolute golden age for horror at the movies, a collective time of cinematic greatness reflected by so many iconic films defining how we look at the genre for decades to come.

title: Shadows of the Circle
overview: A Whispering Tree begins whispering the names of the lonely at midnight and luring them into fog, three college friends set out to investigate the campus legend — only to discover that the truth behind the myth is far darker than they ever imagined.

title: Possession
overview: A remake of Andrzej Zulawski's 1981 cult horror. Plot TBA.

title: Cliffhanger
overview: During a weekend trip with a billionaire's son, seasoned mountaineer Ray Cooper and his daughter Sydney are targeted by a gang of kidnappers. Ray’s other daughter Naomi, still haunted by a past climbing accident, witnesses the attack and escapes. To save her family, she must confront her fears and fight for survival.

title: Spaceballs: The New One
overview: Forty years after the events of the first Spaceballs, the galaxy is once again under threat. A threat so evil, so unstoppable, so completely lacking in any original ideas, that it has vowed to bring back the past... every last bit of it. With Lone Starr in hiding, Queen Vespa on the throne, and the Schwartz stretched thinner than a franchise releasing TV episodes theatrically, the only hope for the galaxy is Vespa's undisciplined son, Prince Starburst, and a mysterious Palace advisor named Destiny. Together, they must find Lone Starr, Yogurt, and any other iconic legacy characters fans are demanding before they discover the hard way that, while some threats you can fight, the reboot is not one of them.

title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
original_title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
overview: At a garden party on a sunny afternoon, Alice is surprised to see her parents’ friend Lewis Carroll transform into a white rabbit. When she follows him down a rabbit hole, events become curiouser and curiouser…As Alice journeys through Wonderland, she encounters countless strange creatures. She’s swept off her feet by the charming Knave of Hearts, who’s on the run for stealing the tarts. Confusion piles upon confusion. Then Alice wakes with a start. Was it all a daydream?

title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

title: Outer Focus
overview: A man slowly loses everything as he tries to keep the last thing he has, sanity.

title: The Intro
overview: This film chronicles the beginning of R&B/Pop icon Zaire Bloomfield's music career through the music videos leading up to the release of his first album. Includes the music videos for ColorBlind, Adderall Redbull, Baddie (Come Around), Chasing Fate (Interlude), Something Dumb, Entrapment of the Heart, & Love Songz

title: The New Mother Earth
overview: The New Mother Earth is a documentary film by Michael Lanfield, based on his book of the same name. With forewords by Damien Mander, Freelee the Banana Girl, and Oberom, and an afterword by Aurora Ananda, the work offers a spiritual and philosophical call to awaken from cycles of fear, violence, and disconnection. Exploring humanity’s need to return to love, truth, and compassion, it presents a vision of healing and unity with animals, the Earth, and one another. Through its message of sovereignty, nonviolence, and higher consciousness, The New Mother Earth invites viewers and readers alike to imagine a more harmonious way of living, rooted in reverence for all life.

title: The Stars That Fade
overview: After a tragic loss, a writer seeks comfort in publishing an anthology of horror stories. As his mental state deteriorates, his imagination blends with reality and tragedy seems imminent.

title: Always Lalisa
overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

title: From the Ashes
overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

title: Suspect: The Road Rage Killer
overview: Examines the case of Tracie Andrews, who claimed her fiancé had been killed in a shocking road rage attack. After a disastrous press conference, she found herself accused of murdering him. Detectives revisited timelines, cross-checked statements, and tested forensic evidence and slowly, the woman who entered the station as a witness found herself at the centre of suspicion.

title: Escape at Alcatraz
overview: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.

title: Fishing Aboot
overview: How bad can one be at fishing? Very.

title: Skeleton Man
overview: Skater boys are terrorized by a delirious skeleton man at a strip mall pizzeria.

title: The Nice Ones
overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

title: Dùthchas: Our Underwater Forests
overview: An animated documentary exploring the parallel loss of marine biodiversity and Gaelic culture and language in Scotland. Six interviews with researchers and practitioners,explore marine ecosystems, capitalism, and rewilding alongside a fully animated visual story. The hand-painted animation is based on underwater sketches, giving it a dreamlike yet accurate look.

title: Follow Me
overview: Go out and play, but be home for dinner

title: Vegas Vic
overview: Vegas Vic follows a mute neurodivergent teenager who, after the recent loss of his father, expresses his grief through making his very own western with a new found friend

title: The Ocean Between Them
overview: A family vacation in Belize turns into a nightmare when a sudden storm strands a young kayaker named Miranda at sea, prompting her mother, Joan, to launch a desperate search.

title: Fuck Mr Flanagan
overview: A journey into the woods causes two stoners to question their friendship and purpose in life - while they try to avoid a devious figure named Mr Flanagan.

title: Art of Destruction
overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

title: Fight for the Fantasy
overview: A divorcée goes on her first date in years and immediately tries to force a love connection over chicken wings.

title: AEW All Out 2026
overview: The 2026 All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on September 26, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, USA. The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

title: The Route to Cappyness
overview: A filmmaker embarks on a global adventure to uncover the viral fascination of the capybara, including exploring how they have become cultural symbols of serenity in Japan.

title: Cat and Mouse
overview: A quiet afternoon in the neighborhood spirals into a chaotic and surreal thriller when Sarah asks her parents for a cat and is forced to learn a valuable life lesson: be careful what you wish for.

title: Stells
overview: The fate of the controversial establishment Bunny Smiles Incorporated lies in the hands of one facility caretaker.  A Walten fan-film based on the hit series "The Walten Files" created by Martin Paredes. We see the true nature behind why Bunny Smiles Incorporated plan to relocate the franchise's lead establishment "Bon’s Burgers".

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: Nightmare School – The Mystery of Professor Marabecca
original_title: Nightmare School – The Mystery of Professor Marabecca
overview: Set in the imposing Kaiser Academy—a private boarding school that looks like something out of a Gothic novel—*Nightmare School* tells the story of Vittoria’s inexplicable disappearance. A group of friends—Isa, Michi, and Gibbo—join forces to search for her, discovering that the school is far more than a place of learning: it is steeped in legend, a guardian of dangerous secrets, and presided over by an authoritarian headmistress who is the heir to a shadowy alchemist founder…

title: Arctic Annihilation
overview: An earthquake in the Atlantic triggers a devastating drop in global temperatures, plunging the world into a deadly, apocalyptic ice age.

title: After the Fire, Before the Water
original_title: After the Fire, Before the Water
overview: It is a Film Experimental is spatial experiment and a live show sound performance.

title: Miles Away
overview: After running away from home, Miles, a troubled teenager unexpectedly runs in to his old teacher. As the two learn they may have more in common than they thought, they're forced to question whether running away can ever really set you free.

title: The Confession
overview: A short story that involves the main character (Hoku) confessing to Mellow about the circumstances that happened with his brother (Cain) and the murder of his best friend (Ben); all the while not understanding the truth of forgiveness and letting go. Will he learn to forgive?

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Granny $tamp
overview: A recently freed parolee, Barney Thompson, attempts to rehabilitate into the society. Things go south, upon meeting a smooth talking, crook, John Smith.

title: Locally Sourced
overview: When a couple’s “locally sourced” dinner turns into an unexpected Ted-talk about their divided community, sinking their teeth into common ground proves to be a challenge.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
original_title: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
overview: Built from an extraordinary archive - thousands of hours of raw home video footage shot across 35 years by DeSean's older brother Byron - this is an intimate, unfiltered portrait of a father and his two sons - their bond, their sacrifices, their conflicts, and their shared pursuit of a better life.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: Knowing Gaze
overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

title: Creatures
overview: In Amsterdam, a queer Polish tattoo artist creates creatures that become part of other people's bodies. Through fandoms, online communities, and kindred spirits, we explore the world surrounding the artist, Pazur Mazur.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: ORBITER
overview: When the government doesn't act enough, two friends part ways as one is sent on a mission to orbit the earth, while the other has to stay.

title: Crawlers
overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

title: Lycanthropy
overview: A young woman wanders through a forest with unease, unaware of the violent creature lurking closely behind. This was created for an assignment in an Audio/Visual Productions class.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: Tainted Love
overview: A man commits a violent act and is proceeded with a call from a familiar person from his past.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Mickey+ Shorts: Mickey + Toy Story
overview: Mickey along with Pixar's Toy Story friends Woody, Buzz, and Jessie celebrates the wonder and joy of play.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Muurbloem
overview: Four of Madelief's best friends join her for dinner. They take a trip down memory lane, while she listens. But as the night continues, her friends push her closer to an uncomfortable reality. Whether's she's ready for it or not.

title: Blues in Tirana
overview: 47 years after the rupture between Albania and China, a young Chinese filmmaker returns to Tirana in place of his grandfather. Alongside three Albanian students, he pieces together the turbulent post-socialist memories of the Sino-Albanian relationship through old photographs, poetry, and the uncertainty of the future.

title: Hair Fetish Killer
overview: Documents the murder, in which Heather Barnett was found with two clumps of precisely trimmed hair in her hands, and which led detectives to Italy. It took eight years before the discovery of a second victim, Elisa Claps, finally led police to the killer.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
original_title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: COLECTIVO: The First Year
overview: Go behind the scenes of COLECTIVO's inaugural year, as three emerging Latinx filmmakers receive mentorship from Lin-Manuel Miranda and Tribeca Studios, culminating in a Tribeca Festival premiere. Three bold new voices. One extraordinary fellowship.

title: SUPURA
overview: When a woman tries to leave her girlfriend’s home, she becomes trapped in a loop that repeatedly brings her back to the same place, forcing her to confront a reality that is slowly eating away at her from within.

title: All We Have
overview: Follows Salem and Dalya,  who fall in love during a dawn raid in a landscape defined by surveillance and military brutality.  As their relationship unfolds across marriage, separation, and the hope of parenthood that magically dares to reclaim stolen time, prison becomes the film’s deepest wound. Its violence does not end at the cell door, but continues inside Salem, reshaping his mind, his tenderness, and his place within the life they are trying to build. A story told through the poetic verses of our Hakawatieh (female storyteller), All We Have is an intimate portrait of love under siege and occupation, and of the psychic cost of captivity.

title: Ghost
overview: a man awakens in a strange and dreamlike afterlife with no memory of who he was or how he arrived. Guided by a mysterious voice and fragmented glimpses of his past, he begins searching for a way back to the life he abandoned—only to find himself confronting the moment of his death once again.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Nuke
overview: A struggling comedian forces herself onto the lineup of New York’s most coveted comedy showcase, using the fallout of a nuclear missile alert to her advantage.

title: Seventeen
overview: Set over the course of seventeen hours, the lives of three young, queer, Indigenous sex workers intersect through chance, relation, and the shared experience of familial and colonial displacement.

title: The Taller They Come
overview: A wannabe Australian film director travels to Ghana to produce his dream film, a kung-fu remake of The Harder They Come with Ghanian action sensation, Samuel “Ninja” Nkansah.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

title: The Apple is Poison
overview: A man finds a mysterious yet threatening note in a bunch of apples.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: The Idiot(s)
overview: Fyodor Dostoyevsky and his wife Anna travel to Europe for their honeymoon and end up staying in a health resort in Switzerland, only to return to Russia after four years. Fyedya can’t shake his roulette habit and keeps losing their money. His wife accepts this fate since he keeps assuring her that it’s all for inspiration and soon he shall write his to-be masterpiece, 'The Idiot'.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: Hammer and Nail
overview: Ondřej Blažek, confronts the raw, untold emotions behind the fight. This UFC-inspired documentary takes you deep into the mind of a fighter, where each punch carries the weight of personal sacrifice, triumph, and inner demons. With high-octane energy and cinematic intensity, Coach Ondřej revisits pivotal moments from his career, reflecting on the emotional turmoil and adrenaline that fuel him. Watch as we recreate one of his most defining fights, immersing you in the brutal reality of what it means to fight, not just against your opponent—but against yourself.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: Just Play Dead
overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Lengwìa
overview: After an agonizing school year bruises his relationship with his well-liked older brother Jonah, socially awkward Teddy meets Cole, a disarming boy, by chance on the street. As their friendship deepens, actions begin to speak louder than words, unraveling the fragile balance between brotherhood, belonging, and yearning during a blistering summer break.

title: Britannia Hibernia
overview: An experimental exploration of travel within the different countries of the two islands. Impressions, dialogue, and music overlap into one another, as experiences merge within memory.

title: Fools of Nature
overview: On the first night of an impromptu journey out of New York City, Malcolm and Jamie trek through New Jersey, eventually stopping to stay the night at a motel. As the night moves along, the two friends are forced to confront their relationship head-on, changing the course of their relationship forever.

title: Amongst Men
overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

title: Three Black Men
overview: Can blackness escape the violence of its origins?  Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

title: South of Seattle
overview: Jane visits an old friend.

title: Elijah Peel
overview: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
original_title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: The Crystal Planet
overview: 11-year-old Rea has recently moved to a distant planet in an outer-space colony where she discovers a mysterious animal cub while her father works in a factory that builds robotic creatures. With the help of her new friend Andy, she must protect the real cub from the factory’s ruthless owner, who intends to turn it into a robotic prototype.

title: Sisyphus
overview: A couple lives an orderly life whilst a third party is dead set on altering their lives for his own gratification.

title: Plano Secreto de Alie
overview: Alie’s Secret Plan

title: Words From The Void
overview: A young man has to grapple with an intense moral dilemma.

title: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
overview: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

title: The Mummy: Reckoning
overview: In the closing days of the Second World War, the SS attempt to manufacture immortality using stolen Egyptian funerary rites. What they create is not eternal life, but a mummified revenant, a sadistic officer bound into undeath by occult ritual. Buried, forgotten, and sealed beneath a British coastal fort, the relic waits. When it is uncovered decades later, the war resumes, only this time it is personal.

title: Bad News on the Doorstep
overview: Chronicles the lives of Frank and Gino, two Italian-American high-school football prodigies amidst the gritty backdrop of late 1950s New Jersey. Beyond the gridiron, they confront a myriad of trials, from the complexities of post-football existence to the allure of delving into the underworld of organized crime. As they traverse this tumultuous landscape, they glean invaluable insights and grapple with profound life lessons, shaping their destinies in unexpected ways.

title: Until You're Alone
overview: After becoming the lead suspect in a series of brutal slayings, a close-minded architect must team up with a free-spirited sex worker in order to clear his name and solve the crimes before they become the killer's next victims in this suspenseful, stylish, and hilarious queer love letter to Hitchcock, De Palma, and the Italian giallo.

title: The Assassin
overview: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the anxiety of the city after dark. A filmmaker struggles to understand the film she is making. A Black single mother refuses the categories imposed on her. A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Lads Being Lads: Screen Time
overview: In this episode, the lads are challenged by James to ditch their phones and begin to connect with life like they never have before. All which leads to the group splitting and ending up facing the unfair reality of their separate paths. All in the hopes of trying something new.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: A Social Contract
overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: So Far and From Now On
original_title: So Far and From Now On
overview: Set in post-pandemic Los Angeles, Ellie tries to rebuild her life through a small online lamp shop after thirty months in jail. Yet encounters with both familiar faces and strangers draw her back to the fear she thought she had escaped.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: Ice Cream Man
overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Little Miss Fortune
overview: A young journalist must find a story in Belfast before midnight or lose his job.

title: Freaks Part II
overview: Several years after a traumatic escape, we meet Mary and her daughter Chloe as they live on the road, hiding their powers and identities. They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

title: EPISODE 12
overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

title: Saliva Agridoce
overview: After years of trying to leave behind the traumas that marked their lives, a couple decides to start over in an old house far from the city. Boundaries between memory, guilt, and the supernatural begin to disappear.

title: The Obelisk
overview: While fighting for survival in the wilds of the Northeast, a drifter unites with a mysterious veteran to expose the truth of America’s demise.

title: Faust
overview: Three artists across three generations are haunted by the demon Mephistopheles in an absurdist reconstruction of the Faustian legend.

title: Scotty
overview: A stray cat (Scotty) has to travel with a pet cat (Katie) despite his desire to return to his territory, but when he gets home, he realizes that living with those he loves is better than living alone.

title: Friends Like Us
overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
overview: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: White Gardenia: The King James Bible
original_title: White Gardenia: The King James Bible
overview: An epic-scaled avant-garde underground project that will cover both the Old and New Testament, featuring segments from various filmmakers and their beautifully extreme visions of the myriad of biblical stories.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

title: EZ Driver
overview: Miguel Matias, a laid-back EZ driver coasting through life, hits an unexpected breaking point when he picks up Ruby Valentine, a suspicious passenger with secrets that attract the wrong kind of attention. What begins as a routine ride escalates into a dangerous chain reaction that pulls Miguel into her trouble, forcing him to navigate rising threats, split-second choices, and a night that pushes him far beyond his comfort zone.

title: Teeth of A Fawn
overview: Bea can’t breathe when her girlfriend’s away.

title: Tether
overview: A woman running an isolated space station receives mysterious transmissions and must quickly unravel who or what is sending them, or an untold number of lives could be lost.

title: Wedding Flowers
overview: A begrudgingly adept, family outcast and her overbearing mother struggle to find connection as their Vietnamese American family reunites for a wedding celebration.

title: The Galley
overview: After being made redundant from her job at the coastal arcades, Helen commits a victimless crime to pay for dinner.

title: The Third Degree
overview: Four young actors in London rehearse an upcoming West End play when their secret affairs with one another become revealed. In twist after twist, they try to outwit each other which soon spirals into murderous consequences.

title: If You Can Make It Here
original_title: If You Can Make It Here
overview: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

title: Artichoke
overview: Held captive in a violent relationship, Cynara discovers a phoropter that opens a portal to another world. In a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase between realities, Cynara finally comes face to face with her oppressor and must decide what she’s willing to destroy in order to survive.

title: Lads Being Lads
overview: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

title: Mala
overview: Reema inherits an abandoned resort on a remote island, and with her three friends, sets out to uncover the truth behind her inheritance. She soon discovers strange locals, cryptic messages from her late mother, and a familial curse involving tantric rituals and black magic. As tensions rise, Reema and her friends must confront their deepest fears to survive the island’s sinister grip.

title: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
original_title: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
overview: A quiet whistling returned from childhood; the calm of a sky and a river dissolving into one another, from which emerges the image of a loved one. For the duration of a reflection, the water reveals memories and offers the delicacy of a glimpse into the course of a life.

title: Crak Hack
overview: In a near-future ruled by VR intimacy, a lonely man's attempt to save his relationship backfires when hackers take control of his device, dragging him into absurd and terrifying chaos.

title: Pure Reason
overview: Starting from a fragment of wall and a daily ritual, an experiment in the perception of colour. How do light and time construct it?

title: I Couldn’t Draw You A Map
original_title: I Couldn’t Draw You A Map
overview: In the divided city of Mitrovica, Kosovo, fragments of a diary, everyday gestures and sounds gathered from the city compose an exploration of separation on multiple levels: political, territorial and emotional.

title: Moana
overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: If We Ever Make It To Someday
original_title: If We Ever Make It To Someday
overview: Law student Cassian, can't seem to let go of his high school sweetheart, Victoria, who seems to have moved on without him. And there's this mystery girl that lingers in his mind like perfume in an old house. With the pressure of the future and the state of the world weighing heavily on him, how will Cassian confront everything he's trying to run from?

title: Our House
overview: Three estranged siblings reunite at the family home for their late mother’s wake, prompting an inheritance battle that turns deadly.

title: Fire Tornado
overview: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.

title: Rain Catcher
overview: In rainy, nocturnal London, photographer Miles obsessively captures unforgiving, morbid portraits of oblivious strangers. When not selling them, he shares them online as 'Rain Catcher'. But soon he notices something unsettling: a mysterious woman watching him and photographing him—turning the lens back on Miles. As her gaze closes in, his world fractures—his work is sabotaged, his name defamed, his loved ones endangered. Consumed by paranoia, he spirals into a dark, delirious obsession to uncover the truth behind her motives. Based on the 2018 short film of the same name.

title: Popeye 4 : Resurrection
overview: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.

title: Daisy
overview: Curiosity gets the better of a whimsical girl when Daisy washes ashore...

title: Robert Richardson: The White Devil
overview: What started as a student exercise and master’s degree project soon evolved into a creative partnership and personal friendship between Jana Hojdová, a former cinematography student at Prague’s FAMU, and distinguished cinematographer Robert Richardson.

title: Gone and Taken
overview: After his brother Jack is kidnapped, Ethan risks everything to track him down. Following clues to a remote house, he faces deadly danger in a desperate attempt to bring Jack home. As time runs out, their mother launches a frantic search, unaware of the nightmare unfolding.

title: Popeye III: Requiem
overview: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.

title: Switch Off
overview: When a seemingly dead phone comes back to life, it begins documenting a man’s reality and his future. As the images turn fatal, he finds himself trapped in a moment he can’t escape.

title: Moodswing Whiskey
overview: A successful but embattled Black entrepreneur, Leo Marks, turns to violence against perceived traitors in his media company as his control slips, culminating in a tragic showdown that explores themes of power, betrayal, and legacy.

title: Christmas on the North Pole Express
original_title: Christmas on the North Pole Express
overview: A woman named Cassidy rides a train to her small, home town, and explores her past, present, and future in different cars in the train.

title: Humans Are Shapes
overview: After having possessed the bodies of two trans sisters, two aliens make a fatal choice in order to obey human codes against taboo, all in pursuit of love and security.

title: Death on the Brandywine
overview: U.S. Senator Daniel Riley is found dead at his grand estate. While the police quickly rule his death a suicide, his daughter Jackie refuses to believe it. Suspecting murder, she asks her life partner, forensic psychologist and professor Millie Park, to investigate the case in secret. As Jackie and Millie dig into the family's past, they uncover a web of dark political secrets, bitter sibling rivalries, and dangerous ambitions. Set against the high-stakes backdrop of a tight election, the couple faces growing danger as they get closer to the truth. They must untangle the lies of a powerful family to expose the real killer before it is too late.

title: Genieology
overview: When a man happens upon a magical genie lamp, its up to his crackshot lawyer to make sure he isnt tricked at the hands of the genie.

title: Time of Death
overview: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

title: Cotton Fever
overview: A mosaic of characters struggle with addiction and love on the streets of Boston during the height of the fentanyl epidemic

title: Looking for Alan
overview: Lilian is worried about whether she can still look after herself and Tom. While she helps him look for something that he can't remember (but it has something to do with football pundits), she has a decision to make about their future.

title: Welcome to Paradise
overview: A woman finds herself in a strange, magical carnival with no memory of anything but her own name. Time seems to be of the essence, can she find her way back to reality or will she succumb to her fantasy?

title: BZRK
overview: Anders’ rage is on the precipice of taking control, fearing he’ll succumb to his violent visions, he seeks the help of a psychiatrist whose mediation methods awaken a power within him.  Short film that screened at Chicago Horror Film Festival 2025. Won Best Horror Director.

title: Something Something Takes
overview: An isolated and impulsive skater, Rager is forced to abstain from fighting, all while being constantly provoked by a paranormal box of censorship.

title: The Legend of Yella George
overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.

title: 742 Evergreen
overview: Two on call police officers respond to a call, where they suspect everything is not what it seems
